import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for the event data. INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title} - Invitation
{event_title}
Date: {event_date}
{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def create_event_invitation(title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: str) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title : str The title or name of the event. description : str A comprehensive description of the event (may include multiple paragraphs and formatting). date : str The scheduled date of the event. notes : str Any supplementary information or instructions provided by the event organizer. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for secure display. """ # Escape all user-supplied content to neutralize any HTML special characters safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) safe_date = html.escape(date, quote=True) safe_notes = html.escape(notes, quote=True) # Render the invitation using the sanitized values return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_description=safe_description, event_date=safe_date, additional_notes=safe_notes )
